programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence  a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: No matter how chaotic or how clean a crime scene appears to be, the culprit is bound to leave something telling behind. Occasionally, it's nothing more than a fingerprint or shoe tread. Sometimes that's all that's needed.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims  And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder  These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark is wrapping up his Argentina hunt and heading to Entre Rios to track down the final two birds on his list: the Rock Pigeon and the Eared Dove. This area is home to over 10 million birds, making it a prime hunting ground. With flocks of pigeons and doves filling the skies, Mark is set for a fast-paced, action-packed finish to his hunt—a perfect end to an unforgettable adventure.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: This hunt tells a story in two parts. The first chapter follows Earl Peterson, Mark’s dad, as he steps into the field with one specific goal in mind. Experience, patience, and timing all play a role as the morning unfolds, setting the tone for the rest of the adventure. The second chapter shifts to Mark’s turn. On the coldest morning of the trip so far, the team heads into black-faced impala country. Wind, shifting conditions, and sharp eyes keep things interesting as they cover ground and look for the right opportunity. Every move matters, and nothing comes easy.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by airand sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: I picked up a $73 water tank and turned it into a DIY deer watering hole. After placing it out and filling it up, I wanted to see how long it would take for deer to actually find it and start using it. It took 5 days before the first deer showed up, and from there the results were really cool to watch. Adding water can be a game-changer for your hunting property, especially in the hot summer and early fall months when natural water sources can be limited. In this video, I’ll walk you through the setup, show trail camera footage of the deer discovering the tank, and share what I learned from this simple experiment. If you’re thinking about creating a watering hole for deer on your land, this is one of the most affordable and effective ways to do it that I have found.

programme.title: Mark Christopher Lawrence

He is perhaps best known for his role as esoteric D.J., Tone Deaf, in the 1994 satirical rap mockumentary, Fear of a Black Hat. He has co-starred in popular films such as Terminator 2: Judgment Day, Planet of the Apes, Lost Treasure and The Pursuit of Happiness. Lawrence can currently be seen in his regular role as Big Mike on the NBC series Chuck. He has made guest appearances on many television programs, most notably Heroes, My Name Is Earl, Crossing Jordan, Dharma & Greg, Malcolm in the Middle, Touched by an Angel, Malcolm & Eddie, Men Behaving Badly, Seinfeld, Murphy Brown, and Martin. He is also featured on the Radio Series Adventures in Odyssey as "Ed Washington".

He was named “Best of Fest” at the Golden Spike Comedy Festival and is the winner of the Finger Lakes Comedy Festival in Ithaca, NY. In 2016, Alex was voted “Best Comedian” by City Weekly Magazine. His debut comedy special “Alex Velluto: Spurious” is currently streaming on Amazon.com.

programme.title: La historia de un gángster
programme.desc: La historia de un delincuente que sale de prisión antes de tiempo por buena conducta, pero este vuelve a meterse en problemas y retoma la vida criminal.

programme.title: La piel de la muerte
programme.desc: Dos mujeres huérfanas protegen un tesoro escondido al que todo el mundo anda buscando en el desierto.

programme.title: Pilotos de Combate
programme.desc: Unos pilotos de la fuerza aérea investigan en una misión antidrogas y descubren a un mafioso que disfraza sus negocios.

programme.title: S.O.S. Conspiración Bikini
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de mujeres hermosas, una organización internacional de terroristas crean problemas en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: Pistoleros bajo el sol
programme.desc: En un pueblo azotado por un ciclón, matan a un investigador. Su hermano, Tony, llega para hacer su trabajo y también lo atacan. Martha arriesga su vida para ubicar a los criminales.

programme.title: El Color de Nuestra Piel
programme.desc: Una familia tiene un hijo rubio al que consiente y otro moreno que se siente desplazado aunque es bueno y trabajador.

programme.title: Matar por matar
programme.desc: La posesión de un revólver determina la vida y la muerte de quienes lo empuñan en un determinado momento.

programme.title: Elena y Raquel
programme.desc: Una joven está embarazada de un novio que la abandonó y odia al bebé, pero al nacer cambian sus sentimientos hacia el menor.

programme.title: Mad Drivers
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes ricos son aficionados a las drogas y a las carreras de autos ilegales, hasta que ocurre una tragedia.

programme.title: El superman... dilon
programme.desc: Un hombre es humillado y explotado por su mujer y su suegra, que lo obligan a hacer el quehacer de la casa, pero en las fiestas de su oficina cambia de personalidad.

programme.title: Judicial pero honrado
programme.desc: Un detective trabaja encubierto para atrapar a un narcotraficante que se dedica a lavar dinero.

programme.title: Los supersabios
programme.desc: Los supersabios construyen un cohete espacial. Panza Y Pola provocan la curiosidad de los villanos Solomillo y el médico. Los muchachos despegan su nave y se encuentran con Panza y Pola para comenzar a explorar.

programme.title: El tesoro de Moctezuma
programme.desc: Santo y dos agentes enfrentan a unos villanos cuando se tratan de robar el tesoro de Moctezuma.

programme.title: Visita al Pasado

programme.title: Santo contra el doctor Muerte
programme.desc: Santo investiga la desaparición de obras de arte originales que fueron suplantadas por copias baratas.

programme.title: El oreja rajada
programme.desc: Dos niños angustiados y un campesino hacen todo lo posible por salvar a un purasangre. El ranchero Andrés quiere deshacerse de él, pero al final reconoce los méritos del caballo.

programme.title: La mafia amarilla
programme.desc: Una pandilla china asesina a un hombre y Blue Demon, con la ayuda de su amigo, tiene que encontrar al culpable.

programme.title: Gladiadores del infierno
programme.desc: Un ex boxeador es envenenado por dos mujeres de la calle y luego recibe primeros auxilios de una muchacha drogadicta.

programme.title: El Color de Nuestra Piel
programme.desc: Una familia tiene un hijo rubio al que consiente y otro moreno que se siente desplazado aunque es bueno y trabajador.

programme.title: Blue Demon contra el poder satánico
programme.desc: Un hombre que fue sepultado vivo quiere vengarse del mundo y el Blue Demon tiene que salvar a la humanidad.

programme.title: La batalla del domingo
programme.desc: La historia del futbolista argentino Alfredo di Stéfano en dos versiones.

programme.title: Sábado Negro

programme.title: Usted tiene ojos de mujer fatal
programme.desc: Un mujeriego finalmente se enamora de una dama que lo hace sufrir y que luego de un tiempo lo acepta.

programme.title: Bala de Plata en el pueblo maldito
programme.desc: Un joven es herido y pierde su caballo, cuando sana reclama una mina hallada por su padre y recupera a su animal.

programme.title: El Herrero
programme.desc: La ex novia de un duque se casa por despecho con un herrero enriquecido, pero un duelo la hace demostrar su amor.

programme.title: El Misterio del Rostro Pálido

programme.title: Tlayucán

programme.title: El hacha diabólica
programme.desc: El Santo es perseguido por el encapuchado del hacha sin saber que se trata de una venganza que tiene siglos de historia.

programme.title: Historia de un marido infiel
